bible_verses.telugu: ఏలయనగా మరల భయపడుటకు మీరు దాస్యపు ఆత్మను పొందలేదుగాని దత్తపుత్రాత్మను పొంది తిరి. ఆ ఆత్మ కలిగినవారమై మనము అబ్బా తండ్రీ అని మొఱ్ఱపెట్టుచున్నాము.
bible_verses.english: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, 'Abba, Father.'

bible_verses.telugu: కాబట్టి నీవిక దాసుడవు కావు కుమారుడవే. కుమారుడవైతే దేవునిద్వారా వారసుడవు.
bible_verses.english: So you are no longer a slave, but God’s child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

bible_verses.telugu: నా దాగు చోటు నీవే, శ్రమలోనుండి నీవు నన్ను రక్షించెదవు విమోచన గానములతో నీవు నన్ను ఆవరించెదవు
bible_verses.english: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for calling me Your child and setting me free from the grip of fear. When anxiety tries to take over, remind me that You have chosen me from the very beginning. Surround me with Your song of deliverance today. Help me to walk boldly in the freedom and security of Your unconditional love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for calling me Your child and setting me free from the grip of fear. When anxiety tries to take over, remind me that You have chosen me from the very beginning. Surround me with Your song of deliverance today. Help me to walk boldly in the freedom and security of Your unconditional love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Fear often tries to define us, but God's love sings a deeper truth over our lives. Through Christ, we are not trapped by anxiety or shame; we are chosen, held, and fully loved as children of God. As you worship today, let His song of deliverance quiet every lingering fear. Lean into your true identity as His beloved child, and step forward into the freedom He has already won for you.
